test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: 12 unskilled and 14 skilled workers together complete a certain piece of work in 9 days. If each unskilled worker takes twice the time taken by a skilled worker to finish the work, in how many days will 12 skilled workers finish the same work?
solution:
**Given:**

12 unskilled + 14 skilled workers complete a certain work in 9 days.

The efficiency of a skilled worker = 2 × Efficiency of an unskilled worker

**Concept used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

Efficiency ∝ (1)/(Time)

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of unskilled workers be U and skilled be S,

According to the question,

(12U + 14S) × 9 = 12S × x

We have, S = 2U

⇒ (6S + 14S) × 9 = 12S × x

⇒ 20S × 9 = 12S × x

⇒ x = 20 × (9)/(12)

⇒ x = 15 days

**Hence, 12 skilled workers will take 15 days to finish the same work.**
